protect.reason: vendored Hairline UI. Restyle with tokens in globals.css, props or an app wrapper; a real bug goes into packages/ui/hairline/patch.mjs, then `pnpm --filter @workspace/ui hairline` (that command rewriting these files is expected). See .agents/skills/hairline-ui/SKILL.md

vendored shadcn, byte-identical to upstream. Change a token in globals.css or pick a variant/size; update with `shadcn add <name> --diff` from packages/ui, or patch through packages/ui/hairline/patch.mjs (docs/design-system.md, Updating shadcn and Hairline UI)
written by pnpm: change dependencies with `pnpm add <pkg> --filter <package>`

denyBash.reason: this repo uses pnpm only (only-allow in preinstall): `pnpm add <pkg> --filter <package>`
a bare Hairline install overwrites shadcn's button/select/dialog. Add "@hairline/<name>" to packages/ui/hairline/items.json, then `pnpm --filter @workspace/ui hairline`
commitlint runs in the husky commit-msg hook; write a Conventional Commit instead of skipping it
shared server: the dev servers on 11091/11092 and other people's processes must keep running. Stop only a process you started, by its PID
the running dev servers use apps/*/.next/dev; deleting .next breaks them
never set EXPOSE_TESTING_API on a deploy build: it ships the testing API (docs/advanced-patterns.md §1.4)
